# Amazon 4U

> Amazon 4U provides web tools, seller resources, and automated AI utilities for e-commerce integration.

## Core Pages
- [Home Page](https://amz-4u.web.app/): Main application overview and core features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://amz-4u.web.app/privacy): Data processing and privacy policy details.

## API & Services
- [Chat API Endpoint](https://amz-4u.web.app/api/chat): AI chat integration endpoint powered by Cloud Functions.
